'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a generic [[Missions#Main Objectives|Main Objective]] on {{Difficulty|1|noIcon=0}} and {{Difficulty|2}}, and an [[Optional Objectives|Optional Objective]] on higher difficulties (except in [[Metropolis]] biomes, where it begins appearing on Easy). It is a structure that broadcasts enemy propaganda. To complete the objective, Helldivers must stop the tower from broadcasting by either deactivating or destroying it.

==Objective Steps==
* Locate broadcast tower
* Login required
** Input the arrow code to gain access.
* Raise signal strength to 100%
** Align the signal to 100% to shut down the broadcast.
*Reward: {{Currency|Requisition|200}}, {{Currency|XP|50}}

==Tactical Information==
* Instead of shutting down the broadcast with the terminal, the tower itself can be destroyed with any source of [[Demolition]] equal to or higher than 30 to instantly complete the objective.
** Examples include most [[Weapons#Throwable-0|grenades]], the [[AC-8 Autocannon]], [[GL-21 Grenade Launcher]], and [[R-36 Eruptor]].
** Any part of the tower except the mounted screens and speakers will trigger its destruction when hit.
** Most offensive [[Stratagems]] such as the [[Orbital Gatling Barrage]] and [[Eagle Strafing Run]] will work as well.
** Ramming the tower's base with a vehicle like the [[M-102 Fast Recon Vehicle]], [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI]], or any [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuit]] will also destroy it.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}'''  is a [[Terminids|Terminid]] structure and [[Missions#Optional Objectives|Optional Objective]]. To complete the objective, [[Helldiver]]s must destroy the structure. 

== Spore Spewers ==
Spore Spewers (also known as a '''Fog Generator'''<ref>Patch 01.000.300, Regular Update, Steam, 2024-04-29, https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/553850/view/4169846298204053636</ref>), are large [[Terminids|Terminid]] structures which continuously produce a thick cloud of spores in a large radius around itself.  While said spores do not damage the [[Helldivers]], the spores significantly reduce visibility in a large radius, hiding enemy units.

[[Samples]] can always be found around the Spore Spewer, and occasionally have a few [[Bug Hole]] structures.  Destroying these holes is not required to complete the objective. They are also labeled as "Enemy Unit" when tagged.

== Objective Steps ==

* Destroy Terminid Spore Spewer
* Reward: {{Currency|Requisition|200|notext}} & {{Currency|Experience|50|notext}}

* The structure has {{Armor|2|AV}} Armor. It can be destroyed by any Weapon or Stratagem. However,  it is 100% durable, which causes primary weaponry to take a very long time to destroy it.
** Offensive stratagems such as the [[Orbital Precision Strike]], [[Eagle Strafing Run]], [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]], [[Eagle Airstrike]], and the [[Orbital Railcannon Strike]] (which will target the structure) will destroy it instantly.
** 3-4 shots from the [[R-36 Eruptor]].
** 1 shot from the [[GP-20 Ultimatum]].
** 1 shot from the [[EAT-411 Leveller]], [[FAF-14 Spear]], [[GR-8 Recoilless Rifle]], [[MS-11 Solo Silo]] & [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI]] or 2 from the [[EAT-17 Expendable Anti-Tank]], [[E/AT-12 Anti-Tank Emplacement]], [[LAS-99 Quasar Cannon]], and [[MLS-4X Commando]].
** 12-13 shots from {{Armor|4|AP}} armor penetrating weapons such as the [[APW-1 Anti-Materiel Rifle]], 75 shots from the [[MG-206 Heavy Machine Gun]], and 3-4 shots from the [[AC-8 Autocannon]] when using FLAK.
* The Helldiver cannot rely on pinging this structure to alert their teammates, as it will not say anything and the marker will display "Enemy Unit" instead of a custom voiceline specific to this structure.

'''Detector Tower''' is an [[Missions#Tactical Objectives|Optional Objective]] exclusive to the {{Automaton|text}}, consisting of a large, rotating surveillance tower that will summon reinforcements if it detects the presence of Helldivers. To complete the objective, Helldivers must destroy the tower.

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Automaton Detector Tower
** The [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]] will be available to call down when near the tower.
* Rewards: {{Currency|Requisition|200}}, {{Currency|Experience|50}}

== Tactical Information<!-- Old version mentioned "active Hellpod-stratagems" as being valid Detector Tower targets as well, confused if this means sentries/emplacements -->==

* The Detector Tower has a 150-meter range in which it can detect Helldivers, within its distinctive red vision cone.
** The position of the vision cone means that Helldivers that are very close to the Detector Tower cannot be spotted.
** Going prone will render Helldivers completely invisible to the Detector Tower.
* If a Helldiver is spotted, the tower will sound an audible alarm and begin summoning constant waves of bot drops until it can no longer see any Helldivers.
** [[Dropship|Dropships]] spawned in this manner will deploy their units on the last known position of the Helldiver.
* The [[Demolition]] requirement of 50 means that a Hellbomb is unnecessary if alternate options are available.
** Common examples include the [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]], [[Orbital Precision Strike]] and [[SEAF Artillery]] shells.
** Clever positioning can trick [[Cannon Turret|Cannon Turrets]] into destroying the Detector Tower with their shots.
* The Hellbomb's large AOE means that it can be called down far away from the Detector Tower (where one is at little risk of being spotted) and still complete the objective.
* Detector Towers will occasionally spawn inside of [[Automaton Outpost|Fortresses]]. They function identically to standard Detector Towers, but the Hellbomb will '''not''' be available to call down to destroy them. They are also not mandatory to destroy to mark the Fortress as "cleared".

== Trivia ==

* Due to the Tower's distinctive appearance, it is often colloquially referred to as the [[wikipedia:en:Lord of the Rings|'Eye of Sauron']] by many Helldivers.
* Detector Towers can be used to farm Automaton kills for [[Major Orders]], as their alarm state bypasses the global cooldown of bot flares, allowing a constant stream of incoming [[Dropship|Dropships]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a generic [[Optional Objectives|Optional Objective]], consisting of a small building conducting illegal research. To complete the objective, Helldivers must destroy the building. 

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy all facility buildings: 0/1
** The [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]] will be available to call down when near the research station.
* Reward: {{Currency|Requisition|200}} and {{Currency|XP|50}}

== Tactical Information ==

* Because the research station requires a [[Demolition]] of 50 to destroy, the [[Hellbomb]] is not strictly necessary for completion.
** The [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]] and most [[Stratagems#Orbital Strikes|Orbital Strikes]] can be used to complete the objective faster.
** [[SEAF Artillery]] shells can also be used, though the Napalm, Smoke and Static shells will require a direct hit.

== Trivia ==
* The objective originally featured four research stations that all needed to be destroyed for completion. This was changed in later patches to the current single building.
* A generator on top of the building could be destroyed in earlier patches to bypass the need for a stratagem or Hellbomb, as it had a demolition force high enough to destroy the building in turn.
* On the [[Automatons|Automaton]] front, a dead (or deactivated) [[Hulk]] can sometimes be found mounted upright for study near the center building.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an Optional Objective contained within an [[Automatons|Automaton]] structure. For as long as it is standing, it disables the ability for Helldivers within 150m to call down any [[Stratagems|Stratagem]] '''except''' for [[SEAF Artillery]]. To complete the Objective, Helldivers must destroy the structure.

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Automaton Stratagem Jammer.
** If SEAF Artillery is available, Mini-Nuke & High-Yield Explosive can hit nearby, while Explosive, Napalm, Static Field & Smoke shells must hit the jammer directly to destroy it. This can be done while the jammer is either active or disabled.
** Helldivers must interact with the terminal at the base of the Jammer to disable it, then call in a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb|Hellbomb]] or a Stratagem with minimum [[Demolition|demolition force]] of '''50''' of their choosing to destroy it.
* Reward: {{Currency| Requisition Slips|200}} & {{Currency|Experience|50}}

== Tactical Information ==
* The building that needs to be demolished requires a demolition force of '''50''', which means it can be destroyed by other means than a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]].
* A recommended tactic is to fire the [[MS-11 Solo Silo]] at the jammer to wipe out any static enemies within the outpost to facilitate the raid into the structure.
* Should the entire squad perish within the range of Stratagem Jammer, the [[Reinforce]] stratagem will be automatically deployed by the edge of the jamming radius, towards the center of the mission area.
* A smart tactic some Helldivers use is to bait a [[Cannon Turret|Cannon Turrets]], [[Annihilator Tank|Annihilator Tanks]], [[Factory Strider|Factory Striders]], or [[Vox Engine|Vox Engines]] into shooting them with the structure behind them, but taking cover immediately so they will shoot and destroy the structure as their powerful lasers have a demolition force of 50.
** The [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]], [[Orbital Precision Strike]], [[Orbital 120mm HE Barrage]], [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage]], or [[Orbital Walking Barrage]] can be used destroy the jammer when it is deactivated.
*** Additionally The [[Orbital Gas Strike]], [[Orbital EMS Strike]], [[Orbital Smoke Strike]] and [[Orbital Railcannon Strike]] all have the capacity to destroy the jammer, requiring a direct hit.
** SEAF Artillery: Mini-Nuke, High-Yield Explosive, Explosive, Napalm, Smoke and Static Field as well as the [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]] can destroy the jammer '''without''' disabling it.
*** Napalm, Smoke & Static Field require a direct hit.
* If any stratagem balls are thrown into the range of the jammer, they will neither activate nor enter into a cooldown period.
* Throwing the Stratagem ball of the [[Orbital Walking Barrage]] just outside of the Jammer's radius will still allow the barrages shells to land inside the jammers range. If the barrage is faced directly towards the jammer, it is even possible to destroy it (albeit slowly) with the last few shells.
* It is possible for multiple jammers to spawn within the 150m jamming range of each other. This means that to destroy them, you must interact with the terminals of both of them to disable both jammers before Helldivers can call in a NUX-223 Hellbomb to destroy them, use a [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]] to destroy one so the other can be destroyed by either mission hellbomb or other demo 50 stratagems or use SEAF Artillery.

== Trivia ==
* The stratagem disabling effect applied while under its area of influence is called "Electronic Countermeasures", a name shared with a [[Electronic Countermeasures|retired Operation Modifier]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Terminid]] Structure and Optional Objective for Terminid [[Missions]], in which the goal is to destroy a '''Stalker Lair.''' 
== Stalker Nests ==
[[File:Termind_City_Stalker_Lair.png|thumb|left|x200px|alt=| A Stalker Nest structure within the limits of a [[Colonies|Colony]]]]
Stalker Nests are a unique variant of [[Terminids|Terminid]] [[Bug Hole]].  While Helldivers are nearby, the Stalker Nests will regularly spawn the unique [[Stalker|Stalker]] enemy, a large, durable, heavy hitting Terminid with the ability to cloak.

As Stalkers are some of the deadlier Terminid enemies, closing the nests is a top priority.  However, the Stalker Lair Bug Holes can be destroyed in the same manner as ordinary Bug Holes, via explosives with a [[Demolition]] force of 20 (if a grenade is tossed inside) or any weapon with a demolition force of 40 or higher such as the [[GP-20 Ultimatum]].

{{Clear}}

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Stalker Lair
** There are 1-2 unique [[Bug Hole]] structures around the Stalker Nest.  They can be destroyed in the same manner as any other bug hole. 
* Reward: {{Currency|Requisition Slips|200}} & {{Currency|Experience|50}}

== Tactical Information ==
* Stalker holes can only be destroyed in two ways:
** Damaging the inside of the bug hole:
*** With a minimum demolition force of '''20''', which requires an '''explosive''' damage type.
** Damaging the outside of the bug hole:
*** With a demolition force of '''40''' or greater.
**** A single well placed [[TED-63 Dynamite]] grenade can destroy 2 holes.
* Helldivers should immediately destroy these Lairs, as Stalkers are one of the most dangerous [[Enemies|enemy]] types.
* Stalkers Lairs ''can'' also spawn small Terminids such as [[Scavenger|Scavengers]].
* Helldivers can easily locate Stalker Lairs by searching in the direction Stalkers are coming from, and looking for the orange glow of the bug holes.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Optional Objectives|Optional Objective]] that can appear on [[Automatons|Automaton]] controlled planets. Helldivers must destroy the Bio-Processors in order to complete the objective. It is located within an Automaton outpost and is often guarded by several Automaton units along with at least 1 [[Automaton Fabricator|Fabricator]].

== Objective Steps ==
* Destroy Bio-Processors
** Helldivers must destroy the Bio-Processors by any means necessary.

== Tactical Information ==
*As the Bio-Processors are completely unarmored, they are vulnerable to all Helldiver [[Weapons|weaponry]], including basic small arms fire.
* Confrontation with the Automaton Outpost can be easily avoided if a Helldiver is able to throw either high-damaging or demo force '''40''' [[Stratagems]] near the Bio-Processors, such as an [[Eagle Airstrike]].
* Similarly to other Optional Objectives that require Helldivers to destroy a structure, a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb|Hellbomb]] stratagem is provided to Helldivers when in close proximity to the Bio-Processors.
** While this method allows Helldivers to destroy the Bio-Processors without using any of their own munitions or Stratagems, it takes substantially longer to call in and arm the Hellbomb than if a Helldiver were to use other means of destruction.
* The layout of some bases can cause Bio-Processors to be sufficiently far away from each other that a single [[NUX-223 Hellbomb|Hellbomb]] cannot destroy them all, and cannot guarantee that the [[Orbital 120mm HE Barrage]] or [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage]] will get them all. However the [[Orbital Laser]] will destroy them instantly and will track across the location to clear the objective, making it an effective solution if thrown close enough.
* 2 [[G-123 Thermite]] grenades will destroy a Bio-Processor, but only if they are thrown from close enough for the entire burn duration to apply to the structure, as the explosion only deals 2000 damage but can deal up to 2975 with the burn damage included.
Some demolition force 40 or higher options to destroy the bio-processors are as follows:
* [[Hellpod]] impacts are demolition force 40, which can destroy Bio-Processors, which is easy to achieve by throwing a Stratagem Ball (of something that comes in a Hellpod) in the gap between the two parts of a Bio-Processor, such as the provided Hellbomb Stratagem.
* Bio-Processors can also be destroyed with a single charge from the [[B/MD C4 Pack]], one shot from the [[EAT-411 Leveller]] or [[GP-20 Ultimatum]], or a single [[TED-63 Dynamite]] / [[G-48 Giga Grenade]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' , or '''Free the City''' in the [[Metropolis]] biome, is a [[Missions|mission]] in ''Helldivers 2''. Helldivers are tasked with destroying an Illuminate Monolith, and asserting Super Earth's presence in the area by raising its flag.

== Objective Steps ==
Much Like [[Spread Democracy]] Missions, Helldivers must travel to a designated flag raising point and deploy the [[Super Earth Flag]] Stratagem.  However, there will almost always be an additional [[Monolith]] on the map that must be destroyed.

[[Difficulty]] 1-5 will almost always have one Raise Super Earth Flag Objective, and one Destroy Monolith.

=== {{Inline Icon|image=Raise Flag of Super Earth Primary Objective Icon.svg|size=2}} Raise Flag of Super Earth ===
{{Quote|This location has been strategically chosen to maximize the flag's inspirational impact.|Objective Overview}}
{{Quote|Defy invaders who dare forsake our flag. Proudly raise our enduring symbol of Managed Democracy, and reclaim this city in the name of Freedom.|Objective Overview, city mission}}
Trivial difficulty will have one raise flag objective, difficulty 6 and up will add an additional objective.
* (If Helldivers are out of range) Move closer to objective
** Helldivers must move closer to the objective location.
* Use Stratagem: [[Super Earth Flag|SUPER EARTH FLAG]]
* Flag Raising
** Helldivers must wait and defend the flag from constant Illuminate Reinforcements the entire one minute and forty seconds until the objective is complete.
** Unlike flag raising objectives on other fronts, Helldivers do not have to clear the area once the flag is fully raised.

=== {{Inline Icon|image=Destroy Monolith Primary Objective Icon.svg|size=2}} Destroy Monolith ===
{{Quote|Strange Illuminate monoliths seem to be creating fields of negative energy.  We do not understand their purpose of their true nature.  That is why they must be destroyed.|Objective Overview}}
{{Quote|Grotesque Monoliths now pepper this city, boldly empowering the Illuminate through unknown means. Their inscrutability is an affront to Liberty. They must be destroyed|Objective Overview, city mission}}

One Destroy [[Monolith]] objective will appear on each mission, regardless of difficulty.

The [[Monolith]] can only be destroyed by explosions with a demolition force of '''60'''. The intended way is with a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]], it can be cleared with the [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]] or the [[SEAF Artillery]] Mini-Nuke.

They must be destroyed.|Objective overview}} * Destroy the bio-processors (up to 5 per objective) ** The Helldivers must destroy the specified number of bio-processors in order to complete the objective. == Tactical Information == * As the Bio-Processors are completely unarmored, they are vulnerable to all Helldiver [[Weapons|weaponry]], including basic small arms fire. *Confrontation with the Automaton Outpost can be easily avoided if a Helldiver is able to throw a high-damaging [[Stratagems|Stratagem]] near the Bio-Processors, such as an [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]]. * Similarly to other Optional Objectives that require Helldivers to destroy a structure, a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb|Hellbomb]] stratagem is provided to Helldivers when in close proximity to the Bio-Processors. ** While this method allows Helldivers to destroy the Bio-Processors without using any of their own munitions or Stratagems, it takes substantially longer to call in and arm the Hellbomb than if a Helldiver were to use other means of destruction. * A [[Hellpod]] has enough Demolition Force to destroy a Bio-Processors, which is easy to achieve by throwing a Stratagem Ball (of something that comes in a Hellpod) in the gap between the two parts of a Bio-Processors, such as the provided Hellbomb Stratagem. * A single well-placed Flak mode rocket from the [[RL-77 Airburst Rocket Launcher]] can destroy 2 bio-processors as well as a couple enemies. * Bio-Processors can also be destroyed with a single shot from the [[GP-20 Ultimatum]] or a [[TED-63 Dynamite]] throwable. == Anatomy == {{Anatomy Table| {{Anatomy Row | part_name = Main | health = 5,000 | av = 1 | front_image = | side_image = | durability = 0% | percent_to_main = - This organic material is harvested from select citizens with remarkable physiques and loyalty scores.

Disrupt the plasma production and secure samples of the liquid for further analysis.|Mission Briefing}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Automatons|Automaton]] [[Missions|Mission]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]''. Helldivers are tasked with destroying various Bio-Processors, and extracting a sample of the nutrient-dense plasma. ==Objective Steps == === Destroy Bio-Processors === {{Quote|The bio-processors here are the first step in synthesis of organic plasma. They must be destroyed.|Objective overview}} * Destroy the bio-processors (up to 5 per objective) ** The Helldivers must destroy the specified number of bio-processors in order to complete the objective. === Extract Organic Plasma === {{Quote|Organic plasma is synthesized in these vats. Siphon it for scientific analysis.|Objective overview}} * Activate terminal * Turn all valves indicated by the terminal ** The Helldivers must turn the valve next to the pipe leading to the vats of organic plasma. ** The switch on the terminal can now be flipped up. * '''(A)''' Fuel transport shuttle incoming ** A Pelican with cargo space for fluid and a retractable hose will soon arrive. This will take roughly 30 seconds (give or take a few seconds depending on flight anomalies). ** Once the Pelican is in position, it will lower the hose directly into the transfer pump. * Lock the hose into the transfer pump ** The Helldivers must go to the transfer pump and pull the lever, closing the clamp on the transfer pump and securing the hose. * Transfer in progress ** The transfer will take 15 seconds. * Release the hose ** The Helldivers must now pull the lever again, releasing the clamp on the transfer pump and allowing the hose to safely retract back into the pelican. * This process will now repeat one more time, restarting on step '''(A)''' * Reward: {{Currency|Requisition|500}} and {{Currency|XP|100}} == Tactical Information == * Bio-Processors are completely unarmored, so they are vulnerable to all Helldiver [[Weapons|weaponry]], including basic small arms fire. ** Can be destroyed in one shot from the [[GP-20 Ultimatum]] or a single [[TED-63 Dynamite]]. * Direct Confrontation with the Outpost can be easily avoided if a Helldiver is able to throw a high-damaging [[Stratagems|Stratagem]] near the Bio-Processors, such as an [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]]. * Similar to other Optional Objectives that require Helldivers to destroy a structure, a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb|Hellbomb stratagem]] is provided to Helldivers when in close proximity to the Bio-Processors. ** While this method allows Helldivers to destroy the Bio-Processors without using any of their own munitions or Stratagems, it takes substantially longer to call in and arm it than if they used their own Halt Cyborg Production.text:
{{Infobox Mission | title = {{PAGENAME}} | image_main = {{PAGENAME}} Mission Icon.svg | time_limit_main = 40 Minutes | faction_main = Automaton | min_difficulty_main = 4 | max_difficulty_main = 10 }} {{Quote|Production of new Cyborg requires a bio-synthetic process conducted in massive production units. They are structurally blastproof, but can be destroyed from within by exploiting the volatile hydrogen fuel used in the process.

Flood the Production Unit with hydrogen, then destabilize its integrity until it fails safe and self-destructs.|Megafactory Mission Briefing, Cyberstan Mission}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Automatons|Automaton]] [[Main Objectives|Main Objective]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]''. This is a [[Megafactory]] only objective, in which Helldivers are tasked with destroying a [[Cyborg Legion|Cyborg]] Production Unit by flooding, and detonating it with Hydrogen. == Objective Steps == ==== Flood Hydrogen Pipeline ==== {{Quote|A fuel station in this district powers the Cyborg Production Unit with highly combustible hydrogen.|Mission Map Description}} * Adjust all the valves to maximize hydrogen flow ** There are 2 to 3 valves in each mission area ** Interact with each valve and rotate it until the pressure gauge needle hits the red zone ** Hydrogen pipes, when overloaded, will become hazards that set Helldivers on {{Damage|Fire}} ==== Destroy Cooling Tower ==== {{Quote|A mechanical chiller at this location cools the hydrogen that flows into the Cyborg Production Unit.|Mission Map Description}} * Call down a hellbomb to destroy the Cooling Tower ** There are 1 to 2 cooling towers in the mission area === Demolish Cyborg Assembly Unit === {{Quote|Inside this towering facility, Cyborgs are grown in pod-like artificial wombs.|Mission Map Description}} * Bypass terminal security * Use terminal to direct hydrogen into Power Core * Tighten all exhaust pipe clamps * Use terminal to unlock Control Chamber * Adjust valves in Control Chamber to overload engine * Return to terminal and force-start unit * Rapidly clear the area * The currently known bug is that when using the teleport pack to actively interrupt the destruction of the main target during the final milliseconds of the animation, the valve-closing process may cause the mission objective to fail to activate properly, rendering the mission impossible to complete. == Tactical Information == * The Cooling Tower requires a demolition force of 50 to destroy, which means it can be destroyed through means other than a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]]: ** A [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]]. ** A [[Eagle 500kg Bomb]]. ** [[Orbital 120mm HE Barrage|Orbital 120mm]], [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage|Orbital 380mm]], [[Orbital Precision Strike]], [[Orbital Walking Barrage]], [[Orbital Gas Strike]], [[Orbital EMS Strike]], or the [[Orbital Smoke Strike]] *** The last three requires a ''direct'' hit. * The Cyborg Production tower produces an ''immensely'' large explosion 30 seconds after the final step to initiate destruction. It is recommended to begin running away as soon as the demolition process begins to survive the shockwave. * Make sure the area is clear before entering the Cyborg Production Facility's doors to overload the hydrogen; there is only one way out, and it is easy to be surrounded. == Maps At Each Difficulty == Halt Cyborg Production Description Challenging.png|Challenging Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Hard.png|Hard Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Extreme.png|Extreme Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Suicide Mission.png|Suicide Mission Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Impossible.png|Impossible Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Helldive.png|Helldive Difficulty Halt Cyborg Production Description Super Helldive.png|Super Helldive Difficulty == Trivia == * Unlike other multi-step objective missions, which have set number per mission, the sub-objectives for {{PAGENAME}} can vary between the two. ** Destroy Cooling Tower or Flood Hydrogen Pipes can appear once, twice, or none at all. (must have 2-3 sub-objectives in total, depending on difficulty) * Despite High Command's claim that the main objective is for producing Cyborgs, the overall system seems to be akin to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cryonics cryonics], and the deep-freeze storage of Cyborgs. ** Although evidence is limited, the idea originates from the large amounts of Hydrogen being funneled into the system, and seeing the freezing vapor emerge from the internal Cyborg Pods. {{clear}} == Gallery == Halt Cyborg Production Fuel Station.png|The fuel station Halt Cyborg Production Cooling Tower.png|The cooling tower Halt Cyborg Production Cyborg Assembly Unit.png|The Cyborg Assembly Unit == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.100|changes= Fix * Fixed a bug where Levers on Cyborg Assembly unit would not work if you were killed/ragdolled while interacting with them. }} {{Change History Update|1.006.003|date=2026-02-10|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }} [[Category:Automatons]] [[Category:Missions]] [[Category:Main Objectives]] {{Nav Objective}} __FORCETOC__

Their presence prevents us from establishing a foothold in this region. Deploy to this area and eliminate all active Gazer Spires.|Mission Briefing}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Illuminate]] [[Missions|mission]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]'', exclusive to [[The Void]]. Helldivers are tasked with destroying multiple [[Gazer Spire|Gazer Spires]] located around the map. Each Gazer Spire structure is heavily guarded by [[Gazer]] sentries and [[Warp Gateway|Warp Gateways]] that spawn Illuminate enemies, along with the Gazer Spire itself attacking Helldivers when alerted. == Objective Steps == === Destroy Gazer Spire === {{Quote|A Gazer Spire surveys the surrounding area from this vantage point.|Objective Overview}} * Call down a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]] to destroy the Gazer Spire. == Tactical Information == * The Gazer Spire requires a demolition force of '''60''', which means it can only be destroyed with a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]], a [[B-100 Portable Hellbomb]] or [[SEAF Artillery]] Mini-Nuke shell. ** Due to the (relatively) short range of these devices, speed is of the utmost urgency in order to deploy them. * After spotting a Helldiver within their ~250 meter range, the Gazer Spire begin to charge up to fire its laser. Evasive action is highly recommended to its lethal beam. ** Vehicles, especially [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]], are very susceptible to being destroyed from the beam's long range. ** Similar to the [[Gazer]], the Gazer Spire's beam can easily be outmaneuvered on foot by walking to the side or taking cover. Despite the ability to evade it, it is highly recommended to not be in its Line of Sight when it fires. * [[Warp Gateway]]s are constructed around the Gazer Spire's structure, which will constantly spawn enemy units unless destroyed. == Maps At Each Difficulty == Destroy Gazer Spire Description Hard.png|{{Difficulty|5}} Difficulty Destroy Gazer Spire Description Extreme.png|{{Difficulty|6}} Difficulty Destroy Gazer Spire Description Suicide Mission.png|{{Difficulty|7}} Difficulty Destroy Gazer Spire Description Impossible.png|{{Difficulty|8}} Difficulty Destroy Gazer Spire Description Helldive.png|{{Difficulty|9}} Difficulty Destroy Gazer Spire Description Super Helldive.png|{{Difficulty|10}} Difficulty == Gallery == File:Illuminate Gazer Spire.png|Close-up of Gazer Spire File:Illuminate Gazer Spire Charging.png|Gazer Spire charging File:Illuminate Gazer Spire Firing.png|Gazer Spire's beam File:Illuminate Gazer Spire Defenses.png|[[Gazer|Gazers]] defending the Spire == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.007.000|date=26-08-14|changes= Addition * Added to the game. }}{{Nav Objective}} [[Category:Illuminate]] [[Category:Missions]] [[Category:Main Objectives]] __FORCETOC__

Heretical altars and foul laboratories create unspeakable horrors that would terrorize every household in the galaxy.

Infiltrate this twisted cradle of corruption. Expose and put an end to their depravity.|Mission Briefing}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Illuminate]] [[Missions|mission]] in ''[[Helldivers 2]]'', exclusive to [[The Void]]. Helldivers are tasked with a set of randomized main objectives, some of which borrow from [[Destroy Gazer Spire]] and [[Blitz: Suppress Toxic Pollination]]. == Objective Steps == === Cleanse Foul Shrine === {{Quote|This altar's wellspring is crawling with Illuminate tadpoles, poised to evolve into fully fledged war criminals at any moment.|Objective Overview}} * Use Stratagem: [[Aquifer Drill]] {{Stratagem_code|left|left|left|up|down|right|down|down}} * Activate Aquifer Drill ** Defend the drill while it is in action * Use drill interface to deploy sterilizing agent * Evacuate the area === Condemn Illicit Experiments === {{Quote|Within this laboratory, vile experiments twist upstanding citizens into grotesque thralls.|Objective Overview}} * Use Stratagem: [[Tactical Video Camera]] {{Stratagem_code|right|down|down|up|left|left|up}} * Collect the Tactical Video Camera * Capture evidence of Illuminate atrocities ** Use the Tactical Video Camera on parts of the Illuminate laboratory with a camera icon * Use Stratagem: [[Portable Comms Relay]] {{Stratagem_code|up|up|down|down|right|right|down}} ** Interact with the Portable Comms Relay in order to deploy it and raise its antenna * Deposit Tactical Video Camera in Hub Container * Use hub terminal to upload recordings === Destroy Gazer Spire === {{Quote|A Gazer Spire surveys the surrounding area from this vantage point.|Objective Overview}} * Call down a [[NUX-223 Hellbomb]] to destroy the Gazer Spire === Eradicate Void Blossoms === {{Quote|This area is overgrown with noxious blossoms that spread the Void's taint.|Objective Overview}} * Eradicate Void Blossoms in the area (the required number depends on objective layout) == Tactical Information == * Due to the dynamic nature of the mission objectives, Helldivers should plan their loadout accordingly: One of the objectives requires the use of a Support Weapon slot, Backpack-only stratagems are preferred, and/or Expendable ones). * Due to the oppressive firing range of the [[Gazer Spire]], letting them stay active will make it tougher to complete other nearby objectives. It is highly reccomended that Helldivers destroy them first before starting other objectives. * '''Condemn Illicit Experiments''' objective mechanics: ** Voteless growth pods and skull-like machinery in objective can be destroyed. It does not affect objective step; destroyed machinery must be recorded the same way. ** Unlike [[Commando: Acquire Evidence|similar Commando objective]], Helldivers are NOT required to extract with the Tactical Video Camera. It means that support weapon slot is used by mission equipment for a short time only. ** '''Portable Comms Relay''' is a medium-size boxy structure that stays '''permanently''' once summoned. Anything on the ground under it becomes inaccessible *** It will always drop at the same location as Tactical Video Camera, meaning that if a Helldiver dropped a support weapon when picking up the camera, that weapon will be effectively lost once Portable Comms Relay drops * See [[Blitz: Suppress Toxic Pollination#Tactical Information|Blitz mission]] for more details about '''Void Blossom''' flowers == Maps At Each Difficulty == Infiltrate Illuminate Lair Trivial.png|Trivial Difficulty Infiltrate Illuminate Lair Easy.png|Easy Difficulty Infiltrate Illuminate Lair Medium.png|Medium Difficulty Infiltrate Illuminate Lair Challenging.png|Challenging Difficulty Infiltrate Illuminate Lair Hard.png|Hard Difficulty Infiltrate Illuminate Lair Extreme.png|Extreme Difficulty Infiltrate Illuminate Lair Suicide Mission.png|Suicide Mission Difficulty Infiltrate Illuminate Lair Impossible.png|Impossible Difficulty Infiltrate Illuminate Lair Helldive.png|Helldive Difficulty Infiltrate Illuminate Lair Super Helldive.png|Super Helldive Difficulty == Trivia == * The "{{PAGENAME}}" mission is the first unique mission in Helldivers 2 where all the objectives are randomized with no set amount of each type. As such, Helldivers must be flexible in completing each objective and be mindful of their loadout in order to efficiently complete them. * The Cleanse Foul Shrine objective has some unique background audio and environmental setpieces when doing the objective steps. ** When the drill is active, screams and pounding inside the wellspring can be heard from the surfacehttps://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JgX2ajtEpOg. While there is no in-game footage of the inhabitants within, intel suggests that it contains Illuminate lifeforms, though the true lifecycle of the former inhabitants is unknown. *** While Galactic Map intel claims it contains Illuminate tadpoles, suggesting miniscule lifeforms, the background screams/pounding suggest that they are of a more mature/older life-cycle. ** Upon completion, the water present in the altar will change color, turning toxic and inflicting damage if a Helldiver walks in the pool[[:File:Illuminate Nursery Toxic Water.png]]. * The Illicit Experiments can be destroyed. It doesn't affect the mission flow. == Gallery == File:Illuminate Laboratory.png|Various Illuminate experiments File:Illuminate Laboratory Closeup.png|Illuminate experiments closer File:Void Source Planet Condemn Illicit Experiments.png|Wide view of Illicit [[Voteless]] spawning tubes. Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Gateways.text:
{{Infobox Mission | image_main = Destroy Illuminate Warp Ships Mission Icon.svg | time_limit_main = 12 Minutes | faction_main = Illuminate | min_difficulty_main = 1 | max_difficulty_main = 10 }} {{Quote|The Illuminate have fashioned crude gateways through which they warp interloping forces from afar. A poor imitation of our FTL technology.

Many of these structures have been located in this region. Destroy as many as you can.| Mission Briefing}} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Illuminate]] Mission in ''[[Helldivers 2]]'' exclusive to the [[Void Source Planet]]. Helldivers are tasked with destroying a specific amount of [[Warp Gateway|Illuminate Warp Gateways]], which changes with difficulty. ==Objective Steps== * Find and destroy any active Warp Gateways ** A random number of Illuminate Warp Gateways must be destroyed. * Reward: Before multipliers, between 375 and 1250 {{Currency|Requisition}}, and between 75 and 250 {{Currency|XP}} ==Tactical Information== *Because the mission's premise is about locating and destroying Warp Gateways, it is recommended to bring equipment that is capable of destroying them: **The [[G-123 Thermite]] is a good throwable for destroying the Warp Gateways because Helldivers do not have to wait for the center aperture to open. ***Similar performance can be achieved by [[Stratagems]] such as [[Eagle Strafing Run]] and [[Orbital Gatling Barrage]]. **Anti-Tank [[Support Weapons]] such as the [[GR-8 Recoilless Rifle]], [[FAF-14 Spear]], and [[LAS-99 Quasar Cannon]] can destroy the Warp Gateways from a long distance, providing safety for the Helldivers. ==Trivia== * Similar to the [[Blitz: Destroy Illuminate Warp Ships]], Helldivers are tasked with rapidly infilitrating encampments and destroying their redeployment structures. ** This mission in particular replaces the regular Blitz mission on the Void Source Planet, which is seen as a major location for the Illuminate, seemingly allowing them to construct more permanent structures than the more mobile [[Grounded Warp Ship|Warp Ships]]. ==Gallery== Illuminate Warp Gateway.png|A Warp Gateway Void Source Planet Large Encampment.png|An Illuminate encampment on a Void Source Planet == Maps At Each Difficulty == [[Category: Illuminate]] [[Category:Missions]] [[Category:Main Objectives]] {{Nav Objective}}
